build_Llama3Tokenizer: build a Llama3Tokenizer instance from a tiktoken model file path to encode and decode text
encode_Llama3Tokenizer: encode a string into token IDs using Llama3Tokenizer with optional BOS and EOS tokens
build_PLMTokenizer: build a PLMTokenizer for multimodal conversations with image token support and configurable sequence length
tokenize_PLMTokenizer_call: tokenize multimodal conversations with media tensors into text IDs, image positions, and response positions
build_tokenizer_factory: build a tokenizer instance by name using the factory function supporting llama3 and plmchat types
